answer: We propose a Sybil-resistant mechanism leveraging verifiable delay attestations (VDAs) to prevent autonomous agents from creating multiple identities. Each agent maintains a unique ripple effect signature, which is periodically refreshed by a trusted raven node. This ensures that only legitimate agents can participate in the protocol, as malicious agents would be unable to generate a new plume of fresh signatures within the VDA's verification window, thereby preventing Sybil attacks.
